name: 10-late-decision-stamps-verdict
description: turn-end is stamped at the verdict, not at the deadline (spec §6): the patience window closes at 4000 but the host deliberates until 6500. The evaluate stays at 4000 (the endpoint a transcript aligns to); turn-end and response-start carry the decision's time, so the response runs 6500-8000 — deliberation latency is visible, not erased.
